mechanism_finding: C produced the study's first strict feedback-conditioned repair: an initial fresh replay failed the frozen repository-effect boundary, the same Agent session changed the program, a later fresh replay passed, and the exact repaired program passed Official EnvBench.
effect_finding: All three arms passed Official EnvBench. This case therefore demonstrates that the retryable loop can operate correctly, but it does not show an Official Pass@1 advantage over either control.
boundary_interpretation: The repaired failure concerned pip installation provenance in a newly created Conda environment, not a missing project dependency. It is valid mechanism evidence under the preregistered v5 boundary and must not be presented as recovery from an Official EnvBench failure.
path_quality_observation: B reached a reproducible direct-install solution in one replay. C used a Python 3.11 Conda environment and required two replays; its measured wall time was 74.85 seconds longer than B. Success remains primary and this is a secondary single-case efficiency observation.

cumulative_gate_state.next_action: Continue the frozen schedule on zappa and neuralforecast before making an algorithm decision.
